review_locator: PMCID:PMC3075501, Type 2 innate immune responses and the natural helper cell; PMCID:PMC3346161, Role of Innate Lymphocytes in Infection and Inflammation
primary_title: Nuocytes represent a new innate effector leukocyte that mediates type-2 immunity
decision_basis: The reviews trace IL-25-elicited nuocytes and their type-2 cytokine output; the cited primary reports intracellular IL-4 protein in cultured nuocytes after IL-7 and IL-33 stimulation.
limitations_preserved: IL-25 defines/elicits the nuocyte population, while the reported intracellular cytokine readout follows IL-7 plus IL-33 culture; do not represent IL-25 alone as sufficient or infer IL-4 secretion from intracellular staining.
